messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming_contbatch_tail.latency.p99 breached 4800ms (SLO=2000ms) on prod-usw2. auto-page sent to #eng-oncall and #prod-ops :rotating_light: https://dash.redwood/prod-usw2/streams?span=5m

suhas: acked. seeing p95 ~1200ms, p99 ~4800ms. spawning paging thread. first thought: mixed seq len amplification in continuous-batching path.

lina: on it. quick check: the rolling avg batch_size increased from 6 -> 28 over last 10m on stream-pool-a, lots of long-seq traffic.

jamal: logs show heavy KV cache churn on the same nodes — eviction spikes coincident with tail. suspect pack-shed where long sequences block small streaming slices.

becky: customer impact? any 5xxs or user-visible errors?

suhas: no 5xxs, but streaming stalls reported by two customers (support tickets #12345, #12347). they see partial tokens then long gap (~4s). classify as P2 customer-facing latency regression.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for model rwd/gptx-13b-q8 on prod-usw2 started 12m ago by infra. No failures reported.

lina: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily cap max_batch_size for streaming queues to 8, 2) enable preemptive shedding for long sequences, or 3) route streaming traffic to dedicated small-seq pool. I can test (1) and (2) quickly.

jamal: preference (1)+ (2) together. (1) reduces packing amplification; (2) prevents long seqs from starving streaming.

suhas: agree. becky, want me to notify support/CS on customer tickets and provide ETA?

becky: yes pls. tell CS: mitigation started, ETA 10–15m for visible improvement, we'll update in 30m or earlier.

lina: running command now:```bash
redwood-admin config apply --pool streaming-prod-usw2 --path continuous_batching.max_batch_size --value 8
```
Applying to pool streaming-prod-usw2...

lina: result: OK, change propagated to 24 nodes (rolling).

jamal: enabling preemptive shedding (threshold seq_len > 1024) with graceful fallback:```json
{ "policy": "preemptive_shed", "seq_len_cutoff": 1024, "fallback": "route_to_small_pool" }
```

suhas: jamal, roll that as runtime flag please.

jamal: done. flag live on 24 nodes. metrics: shedding events = 0.2% initially (expected).

lina: dashboards: p99 dropped from ~4800ms -> 1700ms within 45s of max_batch_size change. p95 now ~900ms.

ops-bot: metric-update: streaming_contbatch_tail.latency.p99 = 1689ms, p95 = 894ms (60s window).

becky: telling CS: "We made temporary batching adjustments and enabled protective shedding. You should see streaming gaps clear up; monitoring shows p99 improved to ~1.7s. We'll follow up in 30m with full postmortem."

suhas: good. next: root cause triage steps while live: 1) correlate customer request seq_len distribution, 2) check KV cache insert/evict rate and memory pressure, 3) evaluate packer heuristics mis-weighting long seqs, 4) consider long-term mitigation (adaptive batch caps or separate streaming scheduler).

lina: I pulled traces for impacted requests: heavy tail requests have seq_len > 1500 and attach to same batch as 4-6 small seq streaming requests. the batch runtime hits 2x compute vs expected, delaying the small streams.

jamal: KV cache: eviction rate spiked 4x during the onset window, and cache hit ratio dropped from 98% -> 84%. looks like the long sequences thrash KV working set → paging (GPU memory pressure) → scheduler stalls.

suhas: notes for postmortem: model topology and compilation may be producing larger RT per-token for long sequences (attention memory increases), quantify per-seq token time. also gather packer logs to see why batcher accepted long seq with many small ones.

becky: customer comms: support updated both tickets, added note that root cause investigation underway and mitigation active.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if SLA impact persists past 30m escalate to SRE lead and page @oncall-engineering.

lina: continuing deeper: found misconfigured packer weight multiplier for streaming (was 1.0 vs expected 0.3) — that explains bias allowing long sequences to join streaming packs. opening PR to revert weight multiplier to 0.3 and add unit tests.

jamal: good catch. PR link: https://git.redwood/packers/merge_requests/1879
suhas: schedule safe rollout after code review. In the meantime, keep max_batch_size=8 on streaming pools as temporary control.

lina: also capturing KV memstat snapshots and dmesg from one hot node. attaching snippets:```text
GPU mem usage: 13.2GB / 16GB
KV entries: 1.2M
evict/sec: 742 -> spike
```

jamal: plan for 1hr triage: run focused replay of mixedseq workload on staging with current packer settings, measure wet latency and packing behavior, then test packer weight change + adaptive cap.

suhas: assign owners: lina -> packer PR and staging replay, jamal -> KV mem analysis and telemetry dashboard, becky -> CS comms and customer-level RCA note. I'll handle postmortem doc and SLO impact calc.

becky: noted. I'll set a customer follow-up window for 4 hours and escalate if any regression.

oncall-bot: Handoff checklist: next oncall (suhas -> jamal) in 30m. Leave current mitigations in place and ensure packer PR merges or revert plan approved.

jamal: I'm taking the handoff. I'll monitor dashboards and keep the streaming cap until packer weight is safely rolled. If p99 < 2s for 20m, we can consider relaxing to 12 batch_size.

suhas: thanks. final quick commands we ran for record:```bash
# cap batch size
redwood-admin config apply --pool streaming-prod-usw2 --path continuous_batching.max_batch_size --value 8
# enable shedding
redwood-admin feature flag set preemptive_shed true --scope pool:streaming-prod-usw2
# rollback (if needed)
redwood-admin config apply --pool streaming-prod-usw2 --path continuous_batching.max_batch_size --value 16
```

lina: logging final metrics snapshot to incident doc: p95=880ms, p99=1700ms, shedding events=0.25%, KV evict rate returning to baseline.

jamal: monitoring for 20m, will update.

suhas: closing live paging for now — mitigation successful and customer-impact reduced. leaving incident open for deep postmortem and code fix.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: paging cleared (auto-page closed). Incident severity: SEV-3 -> monitoring. Link to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/6098765432

becky: awesome work team. will compile customer-facing summary after PM/CS review.

jamal: update at +30m: p99 steady ~1.6s, no new tickets. continuing replay and packer test on staging.

lina: created PR and CI passed, awaiting review. I'll request expedited review from packer owners.

suhas: handoff complete. jamal owns until next rotation.
